Re: Account reference: ACC-528361

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the debt associated with our account, ACC-528361. You have disputed the debt, stating that it is not yours. We understand that you have expressed concerns regarding the potential impact on your credit report and score.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), we are required to investigate your dispute. We will review the account information and verify the debt. We will also review the original creditor's records to confirm the debt's validity.

As per the Iowa Code, Chapter 537, we are required to provide you with information about the debt, including the original creditor, Lakeshore Utilities, and the charge-off date of December 18, 2023. The current balance on the account is $1,718.30.

We will investigate your dispute and verify the debt. If our investigation confirms that the debt is valid, we will provide you with a validation notice, as required by the FDCPA. If our investigation confirms that the debt is not valid, we will take the necessary steps to correct the error and remove the debt from your credit report.

You have the right to further dispute this debt if you believe that our investigation is incomplete or inaccurate. Please note that you may request verification of the debt at any time during our investigation.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
